mapper.select: SELECT sr.record_id, sr.exam_id, sr.paper_id, sr.student_id, sr.total_score, sr.is_final, sr.ranking, sr.created_at, sr.updated_at, sr.extra_info, e.exam_name, e.start_time, e.end_time, e.status FROM score_record sr LEFT JOIN exam e ON sr.exam_id = e.exam_id WHERE sr.student_id = #{studentId} ORDER BY sr.updated_at DESC

SELECT COUNT(1) AS totalExams, COALESCE(AVG(sr.total_score),0) AS avgScore, COALESCE(MAX(sr.total_score),0) AS maxScore, SUM(CASE WHEN sr.total_score >= #{passLine} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS passedExams FROM score_record sr WHERE sr.student_id = #{studentId}

SELECT sr.record_id, sr.exam_id, sr.paper_id, sr.student_id, sr.total_score, sr.is_final, sr.ranking, sr.created_at, sr.updated_at, sr.extra_info, e.exam_name, e.start_time, e.end_time, e.status FROM score_record sr LEFT JOIN exam e ON sr.exam_id = e.exam_id WHERE sr.exam_id = #{examId} AND sr.student_id = #{studentId} LIMIT 1
